text: API keys can be limited to specific note access scopes when created
quote: When you create an API key, you choose which note access scopes it should include.

text: Workspace admins on Business/Enterprise can create non-expiring workspace-owned API keys
quote: Workspace admins on Business and Enterprise plans can also create workspace API keys. These belong to the workspace rather than an individual user, don't expire

text: Official MCP server connects Claude, ChatGPT, and other AI tools to query notes and search transcripts
quote: Connect Claude, ChatGPT, and other AI tools to your Granola meeting notes via MCP. Query your notes, search transcripts, and get meeting insights in your favorite AI assistants.

text: API can be used to build custom agents that analyze sentiment, surface recurring feedback themes, and combine meeting context with other data
quote: Custom AI agents - Build agents that analyze sentiment across your calls, surface recurring themes in product feedback, or combine meeting context with other data sources for deeper insights.

text: Granola Chat answers natural-language questions about your meetings from notes or transcripts
quote: Granola Chat lets you ask questions about your meetings and get instant insights from your notes or transcripts.

text: Chat can be scoped to all meetings, a single meeting, or a set of meetings such as a folder
quote: You can use Chat from your home screen to query all of your meetings, on a single meeting, or in any other set of meetings such as a folder

text: Chat drafts follow-up emails, sends Slack messages, and schedules Google Calendar events, with a review step before sending
quote: Use Granola Chat to draft follow-up emails, send Slack messages, and schedule Google Calendar events — with a review step before anything is sent or created.

text: Recipes save favorite prompts as reusable templates that run with one click
quote: you can save your favorite prompts as recipes and run them with a single click.

text: Note templates can be chosen or custom-built for specific call types such as 1:1s, interviews, or sales pitches
quote: While Granola's default summarisation adapts to a range of formats, you might want to choose a specific template (or set up your own!) for a specific type of call: for instance, 1:1s, interviews or sales pitches.

text: Typing / during a call opens a menu for selecting a template
quote: During a call, type `/` in your meeting notes to open the context menu and select a template.

text: Enhanced notes are generated automatically once a call ends or is stopped
quote: Once Granola has recognised your call has ended, or you stop it manually, it will automatically generate enhanced notes.

text: Your own notes written during the conversation guide how the AI-enhanced notes are generated
quote: You can write your own notes in Granola as your conversation is happening, to help guide how the AI-enhanced notes will be generated.

text: Magnifying glass beside each note shows where in the transcript or raw notes it came from
quote: Use the magnifying glass beside each note to see where in the transcript or raw notes the note came from

text: Can automatically draft a follow-up email after external meetings using transcript, calendar, and past Gmail context
quote: After an external meeting, Granola can automatically draft a follow-up email - using context from your transcript, calendar, and past Gmail threads - so you can send it in a couple of clicks.

text: Prepares a pre-meeting brief overnight with open threads, relevant context, and agenda points
quote: Granola preps you for your meetings overnight. Open your note as you join and you'll see a short brief with open threads, relevant context, and agenda points

text: Export meeting notes to CSV, including titles, summaries, transcripts, and details, for backup or migration
quote: Export your Granola meeting notes to CSV. Get note titles, summaries, transcripts, and details. Useful for backups, migration, or GDPR data portability requests.

text: Connects to 8,000+ apps to automate what happens after a meeting
quote: Connect Granola to 8,000+ apps and automate what happens after a meeting

text: Automatically saves notes in folders to the matching HubSpot contacts, companies, or deals
quote: You can set up Granola to automatically save any notes that are added to Granola folders to the relevant contacts, companies, or deals on HubSpot.

text: Extracts action items and automatically creates tasks in Linear, Jira, Todoist, or other PM tools
quote: Extract action items from meeting notes and automatically create tasks in Linear, Jira, Todoist, or your project management tool of choice.

text: Feeds meeting notes into Notion, Confluence, or a wiki to keep team knowledge searchable
quote: Feed meeting notes into Notion, Confluence, or a wiki so your team's knowledge is searchable and current.

text: Supports transcription and summaries in 31 languages on desktop and 17 on mobile
quote: Granola supports 31 languages on desktop (macOS and Windows) and 17 languages on mobile (iOS and Android).

text: Transcripts can be auto-deleted after a chosen period (1 day to 1 year) while notes are kept
quote: Granola allows you to automatically delete transcripts after a set period of time. This applies only to transcripts — your notes are not affected and will remain available.

text: Notes can be permanently deleted, or accidentally deleted notes can be restored
quote: Delete or restore Granola meeting notes. Permanently remove notes or recover accidentally deleted ones.

text: Notes are private by default and are shared only via link or by adding them to a team-space folder
quote: Your notes are never shared with any participants unless you share the link, or add the note to a folder in your team space.

text: Sidebar separates a private My notes space from a team workspace whose folders are visible to all members
quote: The Granola sidebar is organized into two spaces: My notes — Your private space... [Your workspace name] — Your team space.

text: Copy link generates a unique URL for sharing meeting notes with others
quote: Copy link will copy a unique URL link to the meeting notes, which you can send to others.

text: Speaker tags attribute transcript sections to each participant by name instead of generic Me and Them labels
quote: Speaker tags show each participant's name above their parts of the conversation, giving you more detailed attribution than the default Me and Them labels.

text: Mobile app takes AI-enhanced notes during in-person meetings and outbound phone calls
quote: Granola for mobile lets you take AI-enhanced notes during in-person meetings and outbound phone calls.

text: Works with Zoom, Google Meet, Teams, and every other meeting app
quote: Works with Zoom, Google Meet, Teams and every other meeting app.

text: Captures computer audio directly, so no bot joins the meeting
quote: Uses your computer audio, so doesn't invite a bot

text: Transcribes in-person conversations, voice memos, and any computer audio such as podcasts or videos
quote: It can transcribe meetings (Zoom, Meet, Teams, etc.), in-person conversations, voice memos, and any computer audio.

text: Posts a message in the meeting chat when transcription starts to notify participants
quote: Granola posts a message in your meeting chat when it starts transcribing to let everyone know.

text: Users can opt out of model training in Settings
quote: You can opt out of model training in Settings.

text: HIPAA compliant for Enterprise customers handling PHI
quote: Granola is HIPAA compliant for Enterprise customers. If your organization needs to store or process Protected Health Information (PHI), reach out to sales@granola.so

text: Takes snapshots of shared screens, attaches them to the note, and uses them to improve the meeting notes
quote: Granola takes snapshots of what's being presented, attaches them to your note, and uses them to improve your meeting notes.

text: Connects to Google Calendar or Outlook to show upcoming meetings, create notes from events, and pull meeting context
quote: Connect Google Calendar or Outlook to Granola. See upcoming meetings, create notes from events, and get meeting context.

text: Meeting notification opens the call URL and the Granola note, then starts transcribing
quote: Clicking the notification will: Open the URL for the video call from the calendar event; Open your Granola note for that meeting, and start transcribing
